character: Two large mountains, Whistler and Blackcomb, linked by the Peak 2 Peak Gondola above a pedestrian village in the Coast Mountains about 125 km north of Vancouver. It is one of the largest ski areas in North America, with alpine bowls, glaciers and over 1,600 m of vertical.
learning: Reference note: beginner zones sit at mid-mountain on Whistler (around Olympic Station) and near the Blackcomb base, and lessons run through the resort snow school. Confirm current learning areas and lesson products.
